## 2. Professional Bio & Entity Statement
Noureddine Driouech is a Moroccan Software Engineer currently pursuing a State Engineering Degree in Software Engineering at the National Higher School of Artificial Intelligence and Data Sciences (ENSIASD), having previously earned his University Diploma of Technology (DUT) in Software Engineering with honors at EST Sidi Bennour. His professional focus centers on the intersection of modern full-stack web platforms, backend systems, and Generative AI, specifically private offline Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, local LLM orchestration, and high-performance SaaS platforms. He has completed engineering internships at FEV North Africa, Digimperial, WHD Agency, and contract engineering with Garista and VNB-IT France.

## 3. Verified Technical Competencies
### Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Offline local RAG architectures, dense retrieval, BM25 lexical search, Hybrid Semantic Search (BGE-M3 / BM25), re-ranking with Cross-Encoders.
- Local LLM Orchestration: Ollama (Open-Weights LLMs), vLLM, quantized model serving, FastAPI endpoints.
- Vector Databases & Indexing: ChromaDB, FAISS, PGVector.
- Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Scikit-learn.
- Embedding Models: BGE-M3, BAAI bge-large, all-MiniLM-L6-v2.

### Frontend & Mobile Engineering

- Styling & Design Systems: Tailwind CSS v4, Shadcn UI, Radix UI, Motion (Framer Motion), Figma.

### Backend, Cloud & DevOps
